description:
Research Summary

Surrey Morphology Group is recruiting a PhD student to compare predictability in Romance verbal inflection.

The studentship forms part of the UKRI Future Leaders Fellowship project Scaling Predictability in Morphological Paradigms.

Official Project Title

Fully funded PhD studentship on predictability in Romance verbal inflection

Research Focus and Methods

Develop and apply computational measures of the information speakers use to infer word forms. Compare contemporary and historical Romance datasets to investigate how morphological predictability varies and changes.

Research Training and Development

Computational methodology can be learned during the project; prior technical expertise is not required.
